rules.shubhvelaWins: Where a word exists in Shubhvela ui/{hi,bho}.json or the engine locale tables, that spelling is binding (brief 2.3): बियाह, बरत, जनम, नाँव, दक्खिन, पूरब, पच्छिम, एतवार सोमार मंगर बुध बियफे सुक सनिचर, चइत बइसाख जेठ असाढ़ सावन भादो आसिन कातिक अगहन पूस माघ फागुन, सतभिखा.
rules.bhoRetroflexN: Bhojpuri writes ण as न in everyday / tadbhava words (कारन, परिनाम, चरन, उदाहरन, परनाम); Sanskrit mantra words, deity names and shastric technical terms keep ण (गणेश, नारायण, पुराण, ब्राह्मण, करण, पूर्णाहुति).
rules.bhoNukta: Bhojpuri uses nukta only in ड़ / ढ़ (जरूरत, तारीख, आवाज, साफ; never ज़ फ़ ख़).
rules.hiNukta: Hindi uses ज़ / फ़ in loanwords whose standard pronunciation has z / f (ज़रूरत, ज़्यादा, फ़ोन, फ़र्क); ख़ only in तारीख़ to agree with Shubhvela; no क़ / ग़.
rules.digits: Latin digits everywhere in hi / bho / en UI and prose (Shubhvela convention); Devanagari digits only inside the devanagari mantra field when the source has them.
rules.honorific: Deities and planets take the respectful plural in hi (… हैं) and bho (… बाड़न); "जी" after a deity name in family-register prose (गणेश जी), not inside mantra glosses.
